title: Former MYMP vocalist Mela finds new home in pop-rock band CRiB

blocks.text: Former MYMP vocalist Mela is embracing a new musical chapter as the newest member of pop-rock band CRiB, saying she has found a second family among her all-male bandmates. During an interview with select media on Wednesday, Nov. 4, the singer, whose real name is Carmella Ravanilla, shared that adjusting to working with an all-male group came naturally to her, “Parang hindi ako nahirapan kasi sa family ko naman meron din ako two brothers. Ako lang yung only girl. So, parang ganun din. So, wala namang pinakaiba,” she said. “Ang dami ko kasing mga aral napupulot sa kanila dahil sa edad. […]...
